event: 2025 Rooster-Monautix EurILCA Europa Cup and High Performance Grand Prix
procedural_matters: GBR 222281 was represented by Archie MUNRO-PRICE.
The race committee was represented by Benedek FLUCK.
The race committee provided video evidence.
Dániel HOLLÓ (member of race committee) gave evidence as a witness.
Wolfgang REISINGER (member of the international jury) and Réka ABDAI (member of the race committee) attended the hearing as observers.
facts: The race committee displayed the black flag as preparatory signal during the third attempt to start race 1 of the ILCA 6 class.
The race committee identified GBR 222281 in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark, close to the pin-end, during the last seconds to start.
The race committee scored GBR 222281 as BFD in race 1.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
decision: Request for Redress Request No.: 01 Date & Time: 2025-09-13 17:07 CEST Printed: 2025-09-13 17:34 DECISION Redress is not given.
